__comment: Starter Worker recipes. CraftingManager is the single data owner. ingredient_count matching timber units per batch, plus one unit per additional_ingredients entry, physically collected before work. output_count is finished units. Finite quantities are batches; maintain quantities are spare units. The first bench needs no workshop. Tools can be crafted and stored; equipment and specialist professions remain planned.

recipes.name: Crude workbench
recipes.description: A rough stump with an axe-hewn top for the colony's first crafts. Workers can make it on clear ground, then haul and install it through Place.

recipes.name: Log torch
recipes.description: A charred branch bound with rough fibre and held by a wooden wall peg. A basic light for the first tunnels.

recipes.name: Ladder section
recipes.description: Split raw timber into pegged rails and rungs. Each section installs four blocks; taller routes need several sections.

recipes.name: Log bridge kit
recipes.description: Split and peg timber for a two-block-wide crossing. One kit spans one to five water blocks between matching-height banks.

recipes.name: Campfire
recipes.description: A low outdoor stone-ring fire, centered in a 3 × 3 camp area. Place log stools around its edges to gather by the light.
recipes.purpose: Outdoor gathering and light. Always lit when installed; no fuel upkeep yet.

recipes.name: Rudimentary hearth
recipes.description: A compact 2 × 2 stone room heater with a stacked back, open firebox and glowing coals. Two matching logs and four rough stones.
recipes.purpose: Warms a small enclosed bedroom. Face the opening into the room; larger rooms may need more heat. Always lit when installed; no fuel upkeep yet.

recipes.name: Log stool
recipes.description: A short log cut flat for sitting, with rough bark sides. A simple stump seat for the first camp.
recipes.purpose: Idle dwarves can sit here and return to work when needed.

recipes.name: Stone hoe
recipes.description: A shaped stone blade fitted to a wooden haft for the colony's first fields.
recipes.purpose: Farmer starter tool. Farming and equipping tools are planned; this item can be crafted and stored.

recipes.name: Hunting spear
recipes.description: A stone-tipped wooden spear. A simple hunting weapon that needs no metal or bowstring.
recipes.purpose: Hunter starter tool. Player hunting and equipping weapons are planned; this item can be crafted and stored.

recipes.name: Crude carpentry kit
recipes.description: A wooden mallet and stone adze for rough woodworking. An iron saw can be a later upgrade.
recipes.purpose: Required to promote a Carpenter. The dwarf collects and equips this kit. Specialist workshop and recipes are planned.

recipes.name: Stone hammer
recipes.description: A heavy stone head fitted to a wooden handle for the colony's first metalworking tools.
recipes.purpose: Blacksmith starter tool. Smelting, forging and equipping tools are planned; this item can be crafted and stored.

recipes.name: Log door (2 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 2-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.

recipes.name: Log door (3 wide)
recipes.description: One rough log leaf swings open as dwarves approach. Fits a 3-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.

recipes.name: Double log door (4 wide)
recipes.description: Two rough log leaves swing open as dwarves approach. Fits a 4-block-wide opening and seals the room for warmth.

recipes.name: Log bench
recipes.description: An axe-hewn half log resting on two stout log supports. Simple camp seating.

recipes.name: Log bed
recipes.description: Fit rough logs into a low frame and heap it with hay and dried leaves. A simple place for one dwarf to sleep.
recipes.purpose: Dwarves prefer a free bed over the ground. A bed, door, light and sealed enclosure make a bedroom.

recipes.name: Log Fence Post
recipes.description: Place posts at neighboring grid corners. Two level rails connect each adjacent pair, forming straight runs, corners and junctions.
recipes.purpose: Place posts at neighboring grid corners. Two level rails connect each adjacent pair, forming straight runs, corners and junctions.

recipes.name: Log Gate
recipes.description: A two-edge gate between grid corners, sharing posts with connected fences. Opens as dwarves approach and does not seal a room.
recipes.purpose: A two-edge gate between grid corners, sharing posts with connected fences. Opens as dwarves approach and does not seal a room.

recipes.name: Board-game Table
recipes.description: A game scratched into a rough-cut log, with loose stones for counters. Add two separate log stools for a game together that restores happiness.
recipes.purpose: A game scratched into a rough-cut log, with loose stones for counters. Add two separate log stools for a game together that restores happiness.

sections.name: Rudimentary
sections.hint: Simple goods and starter tools, made by Workers at the crude workbench.

sections.name: Carpenter
sections.description: Refined wooden furniture, storage and workshop fittings.
sections.requirements: Promote with a crude carpentry kit. Specialist workshop and recipes are planned; a forged saw comes later.
sections.hint: Craft a kit under Rudimentary â†’ Starter tools, then promote a dwarf through Colony â†’ Profession.

sections.name: Stonemason
sections.description: Shaped stone furnishings and the colony's first substantial stonework.
sections.requirements: Specialist recipes, workshop and promotion requirements are still being designed.

sections.name: Blacksmith
sections.description: Refine metal and forge better tools, fittings and workshop equipment.
sections.requirements: Entry tool: stone hammer. Iron pickaxes and carpenter saws are future upgrades.
sections.hint: The stone hammer is available under Rudimentary â†’ Starter tools.

sections.name: Weaponsmith
sections.description: A later Blacksmith specialization for military weapons.
sections.requirements: Planned progression: experienced Blacksmith and a working forge.
sections.hint: Weapon recipes and crafting are planned.

sections.name: Armorsmith
sections.description: A later Blacksmith specialization for protective equipment.
sections.requirements: Planned progression: experienced Blacksmith and a working forge.
sections.hint: Armor recipes and crafting are planned.

sections.name: Farmer
sections.description: Grow and harvest crops to supply food, drink and other professions.
sections.requirements: Entry tool: stone hoe. Farming will use field work; its production controls are still planned.
sections.hint: The stone hoe is available under Rudimentary â†’ Starter tools.

sections.name: Hunter
sections.description: Hunt wildlife and supply the colony with food and animal materials.
sections.requirements: Entry weapon: hunting spear. Player hunting and processing are planned.
sections.hint: The hunting spear is available under Rudimentary â†’ Starter tools.

sections.name: Miner
sections.description: Miners already specialize in excavation. Their equipment progression will be supplied by other crafts.
sections.requirements: Miner promotion uses the default pickaxe today. Iron and later metal upgrades will be made by smiths.
sections.hint: Miner is playable; this equipment section is a preview, with no Miner crafting recipes yet.

sections.name: Brewer
sections.description: Turn farm harvests into drinks for the colony.
sections.requirements: Brewing recipes, ingredients and production controls are planned.
sections.hint: Farming and brewing production will be added in later milestones.
